checks.check: all-width/all-kind bucket-read permissions, promotion, bags, deletion, reuse, and refusal passed
checks.recipe-check: recipe exact and widened access, guard thresholds, poisoned neighbors, independent bytes, damage and refusal passed
checks.links-check: checked/admitted reservations, refusal, relocation, clones and all-family physical/event parity passed

codegen.phase_assignment: DWARF inline caller locations matched to frozen source assignments; no clock ordinal or lambda number

limitations: Single-writer exclusive-owner experiment. No concurrent writer, MVCC publication, DRAM, Loom prefetch or established cache-residence claim.

Combined cached link-format pointer and byte-coordinate read change; local-result caller in all arms. Versus the earlier paired capture, requested storage and build populations match for comparable arms, but metadata increases 8 B per set/map owner and 16 B per multimap owner. These separate jobs are not a matched causal decomposition.

All 45 cases and all 10 arms retained: exact/wider-FP/wider-suffix/wider-both, composed/Direct, ordinary/exact-key Abseil. One fresh process per case/arm in shuffled seed 127 order; nine fresh-Pool reps and complete read warmup. Process placement, temporal drift and Abseil seed differences remain; within-process reps are not independent machine trials.

Requested bytes plus metadata, geometry, build populations and operation counts match per repetition across the eight candidate arms. Owned backing is retained; baseline backing zero means unknown. No transient peak, RSS or cache-residence measurement.

Wider reads require stable initialized ownership of the complete bucket, mask inactive neighbors and preserve exact store/damage bounds. Widening often changes no loaded bytes; identical helper controls retain those negative cases. This is not permission to read independently mutable neighboring storage.

K8..64, set/map/multimap, A6/A10 except K8A6 only, exact arbitrary-fit bucket recipes. Cardinality follows the explicit historical capacity control; formats are not compared at their own equal occupancy. K8 bypasses compact-list policy.
Direct replaces bucket-field operations only; owner, hashing, routing and chains stay common. It is not an independent whole table.

Timing uses std::chrono::steady_clock. Hit/miss results have independent per-key checks. Map serial depends on values; multimap XORs all values and proves the complete cycle; set serial includes caller dependency.
Full lifetime sums separately timed construct/build/update/erase/release. Reads, inventories, checks and Pool setup/drain are excluded. This is not uninterrupted lifetime throughput.

Inventory is after build for construct/build/read, after update for update, and after erase for erase/release/lifecycle. Population fields always describe build. Data backing histories are retained but equality is not assumed.

Abseil reserves known cardinality in construct. Its InlinedVector<word,1> actually holds two inline values on these ABIs; candidate holds one. Multimap append allocation asymmetry remains and is not the separate admitted-append experiment.
Host ISA and microarchitecture change together (Zen5 AVX2 x86-64-v3, Granite native AVX512, V2 NEON); this is not an ISA-only comparison.

Complete timed CFG and helper audit resolves phase through frozen-source DWARF callsites, including outlined timers. It establishes call boundaries, not runtime branch frequency, PMU profiling or cycle causality. Medians across cases are descriptive; no default or preset is selected.
selection: All native case/arm/repetition rows and populations retained. Full source, compile commands, binary and assembly recoverable via artifact.json.
